title: Seed Dispersal
summary: Wings, parachutes, hooks, tasty fruits, floating husks and exploding pods: how plants send seeds away.

ib.note: Links to adaptation and ecology in Unit 8

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 12: Reproduction in Plants

objectives: I can explain why seed dispersal is important.
I can describe dispersal by wind, water, animals and explosion, with examples.
I can predict how a seed is dispersed from its features.
misconceptions: Seeds are just dropped under the parent.
All seeds are spread by wind.
Animals eating fruit destroy all the seeds.
